description: This PHP source file defines the AuthorizationController class within the OrangeHRM OAuth plugin. The class handles authorization requests, manages user authentication status, and interacts with OAuth server components to validate authorization requests. It also prepares Vue.js components for rendering OAuth authorization pages, including error handling and client branding.

classes.name: AuthorizationController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling OAuth authorization requests within the OrangeHRM platform. Implements pre-render logic to check user authentication, validate OAuth authorization requests, and prepare Vue components with relevant data and error states.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the authorization view, verifying user authentication, processing OAuth authorization requests, handling exceptions, and setting up the Vue component with necessary props for rendering.
